stem.text: A stationary insect on the surface of water creates circular waves with its legs, as shown in diagram 1. The insect begins to travel to the right as shown in diagram 2.

stem.alt: Two diagrams of circular water waves around a dot labelled insect, with a point marked X to the right of the dot; the drawings are labelled diagram 1 and diagram 2.

stem.text: Which row describes the change to the waves at X caused by the movement of the insect?
